description: This file contains the implementation of the parseDoctype function for parsing HTML doctype tokens, including handling quirks mode detection based on doctype identifiers.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents an HTML node, specifically used here for Doctype nodes with attributes.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute key-value pair for HTML nodes.

methods.name: parseDoctype
methods.description: Parses a string representing a doctype token into a Node with attributes and determines if quirks mode should be enabled.
